paragraphs.text: A hotkey binder plugin for dsh, allows user to bind specific keys to trigger dictation.
# dsh-dictation-hotkey

Press-to-talk dictation for the DSH Web composer. Hold a key combination, speak,
release — DSH's own

speech engine transcribes it and the text lands in the
composer.

The plugin adds **no second recognizer**: it drives the speech Remote that DSH
already ships with it

s voice-input bundle (local SenseVoice, CPU) and inserts the
result through the official composer ac

e-input bundle (local SenseVoice, CPU) and inserts the
result through the official composer actions.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it does

- **Push to talk**: `hold` (record while held) or `toggle` (press to start, press
to stop) trigger m

odes.
- **Fill or send**: insert the transcript for review, or submit it immediately.
- **Reuses DSH

's engine**: the same local SenseVoice provider the official
microphone button uses — no extra proce

ss, model download, or cloud API.
- **Composer-native insertion**: text is spliced into the live dra

ft through
`inputActions.insertText`, so the caret, references, and attachments survive.
- **Configu

rable per browser**: hotkey, mode, send behaviour, beeps, and
diagnostics live in a popover on the c

omposer pill (`localStorage`).
- **Works on the new-conversation screen too**: with no session open

there is no
composer draft to splice into, so the transcript is pasted into the focused
composer as

a normal edit, and the pill returns with the first session.
- **Diagnosable**: optional per-keystrok

e log with audio level, audio length, and
inference time, which separates "nothing was picked up" fr

om "the recognizer
missed it".
## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or a compatible release, Web profile.
- The official **voice input** bundle enabl

ed (plugin manager → 语音输入). It
provides the speech engine; without it the pill reports that no recog

r → 语音输入). It
provides the speech engine; without it the pill reports that no recognizer is
mounted.
## Install

Then reload the Web UI. The bundle is committed at `client/dist/client.js`, so a
checkout works with

eb UI. The bundle is committed at `client/dist/client.js`, so a
checkout works without a build step.

Updating later: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey`
again and r

estart `dsh web` — a profile keeps its own copy of the installed
package, so pushing to GitHub does

not update an already-installed profile by
itself.
## Use
A **🎙 Dictation** pill appears under the composer:
| Action | Result |

| Hold `Ctrl+Shift+Space`, speak, release | Transcript inserted into the composer |
| Click the pill
| Settings: hotkey (press the keys to capture), fill ↔ send, hold ↔ toggle, beeps, diagnostics |

Releasing **any** key of the combination ends the recording, so there is no need
to lift them togeth

easing **any** key of the combination ends the recording, so there is no need
to lift them together.

On the home screen (no session yet) the pill is absent — the composer dock only
exists inside a sess

ion — but the hotkey still works: the controller stays armed
through a root-scope seat and the trans

cript is pasted into the focused composer.
Auto-send is skipped there, so sending stays your own key

s pasted into the focused composer.
Auto-send is skipped there, so sending stays your own keystroke.
## Settings
Stored per browser under `localStorage` key `dsh-dictation-hotkey.settings`.
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `hotkey` | `Ctrl+Shift+Space` | `+`-separated combination; `Space`, `F9`, `Alt+~`, letters and dig

its are understood |
| `mode` | `hold` | `hold` = record while held, `toggle` = press to start/stop

|
| `autoSend` | `false` | Submit the draft as soon as the transcript is inserted |
| `beep` | `true

` | Short tones for start, stop, and failure |
| `language` | *(empty)* | Recognition language hint;

empty follows the DSH speech settings |
| `providerId` | *(empty)* | Speech provider id; empty uses

the deployment default |
| `minRecordMs` | `150` | Presses shorter than this are rejected with a vi

sible notice |
| `tailMs` | `180` | Audio kept after release, so a fast release does not clip a syll

able |
| `maxRecordSeconds` | `60` | Safety stop |
| `debug` | `false` | Keep the keystroke log |
## Diagnostics

Enable **诊断日志** in the popover; each keystroke then records a structured entry,
mirrored to the DevT

ools console and kept as a 20-entry ring buffer in
`localStorage` (`dsh-dictation-hotkey.log`, copy/
clear buttons in the popover).
| `event` | Meaning |

| `start` | Microphone ready — `micStartMs`, triggering keys `heldCodes` |
| `stop` | Released — `he

ldMs`, `tailMs` |
| `ok` | Recognized — `audioSeconds`, `inferenceMs`, `chars`, `peakDb` |
| `empty-
transcript` | Engine returned nothing — carries `peakDb`; `quiet: true` means the recording itself w

as near-silent |
| `skip` | Rejected by a threshold: `shorter than minRecordMs`, `empty audio`, `spe

ech remote absent` |
| `transcribe-failed` / `mic-failed` / `insert-conflict` / `finish-threw` | Cor
responding failure |

`peakDb > -45` with an empty transcript points at the recognizer (adjust
`language`); `peakDb < -45`
means that take carried no usable sound.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`verify.mjs` exists because Cordis throws when a plugin reads a service it did
not declare (`cannot

get property "slots" without inject`) while the Web shell
only prints `web boot: 1 entry did not act

ivate` — a diagnostic dead end this
plugin hit once, now a build-time check. `test-release.mjs` cove

rs sloppy release
order, double taps, sub-threshold presses, empty transcripts, and auto-send.
## How it is wired
| Piece | Where |
| Hotkey, microphone, WAV encoding, state | `client/src/{index,controller,hotkey,audio,settings,ui}.

ophone, WAV encoding, state | `client/src/{index,controller,hotkey,audio,settings,ui}.js` |

## Limitations

- Keys are handled while the DSH page is focused. A key pressed with another
window in front never r

eaches the plugin; system-wide support needs an OS-level
helper and is not implemented.
- Microphone

permission is granted for the DSH origin. The first ever use may
require clicking the official micr

ophone button once.
- Recording is capped by `maxRecordSeconds` and by the Remote's own audio limits
